items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Now, I met Stuff in Buffalo, at the time I was with Willie Bryant.

ctx.x: For RCA. But, well let's see, you were with Willie, and then the next thing I see in Chilton is that you were with Stuff Smith.

After Willie. Now, I met Stuff in Buffalo, at the time I was with Willie Bryant. We was working this club in Buffalo that I couldn't think of the name, and Stuff is out of Buffalo, that's his home. He used to come by down at the Union and Stuff and I used to sit downstairs and jam in the afternoon, and that's how we become acquainted.
Was he still with Alphonso Trent or was that later?
